## CookieExpiryInfo.rawExpires property

The raw value of the last `Expires` attribute in the `Set-Cookie` string, or `null` if there was none. Only available when the cookie was parsed from a string with recording enabled.

**Signature:**

```typescript
rawExpires: string | null;
```
